node.statement: Complete the raw-call record before invoking lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement as follows. Its explicit target corner/ambient is T:=A, with recorded target-ambient defect epsilon. For m>1 let v_raw:C^{m-1} direct_sum C^2 -> A be the literal sum of v_old and v_fresh after their supplied corner-to-A inclusions, identify the source with C^{m+1}, and take its fixed amplifications to be the corresponding sums of the fixed families from nodes 1.3 and 1.4; for m=1 set v_raw:=v_fresh:C^2->A and use its supplied family. Record the Stage-1 tag, input map w, source, T, P_old,P_fresh, base scale t_1, and the post-helper component scales from nodes 1.3-1.4. Finally, already at this pre-invocation stage define the required recorded field d_raw to be D_1*t_1 when m>1 and C_pair*L*epsilon when m=1. This introduces a candidate record field, not an assumed estimate: def-maincb-raw-call explicitly states that recording d_raw does not assert that v_raw is an extended inclusion or isomorphism. Hence there is no circular use of the desired conclusion. The antecedent of lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement instead asks for the component projection, complementarity, old/fresh-map, and target-ambient defects; nodes 1.1-1.4 bound each by t_1<=e_1. The external lemma may therefore be invoked on this now-complete datum, and its conclusion establishes the claimed D_1*t_1 output estimate in the m>1 branch, while node 1.3 already establishes the recorded fresh estimate in the m=1 branch.
